report.root_cause: 无法在有界证据内确定 front-door /submit 500 风暴的根因：错误窗口内的上游异常/连接获取遥测缺失，唯一保留的错误日志字段被脱敏，依赖服务在该窗口无采样，无法区分连接池耗尽、依赖超时与配置错误。
report.explanation: 观测到的事实（synthetic 冻结快照，2026-10-01）：1) front-door 11:24-11:26 /submit 500 为 420/6000（约 7%，与上报一致），对照 11:20-11:23 为 3/9000（约 0.03%），窗口内 CPU 26%、内存 380 MiB，本地资源无明显饱和（ev_4b9bf3276a19）。2) 唯一存活错误事件：route=/submit、http_status=500，但 exception_class、detail、trace_id、upstream_name 均被脱敏/未记录（ev_423d91c387c3），因此既不能证实连接池/超时异常，也无法指向具体上游。3) front-door 配置增量同步在 11:21 失败，11:24-11:26 的运行时回读与版本成员未被保留（ev_8753dba7df6f）——这是遥测缺失，不构成「配置变坏」的证据。4) invoice-api 最后成功抓取为 11:23（p95 41ms、错误率 0.1%），11:24-11:29 无成功抓取且未补零（ev_096b30ea4a65）；account-api 11:20-11:28 无采样，仅 11:29 有 p95 36ms、错误率 0.0%（ev_d1228be67124）；event-store 在 11:25-11:26 有采样且健康（query p95 9ms、lock_waiters=0），但未测量按调用方的连接状态或应用侧连接获取（ev_563b24dc82a1）。竞争解释：连接池耗尽（H1）、依赖超时（H2）、错误配置（H3）均有部分相容现象，但都缺少能相互区分的窗口内观测——没有任何连接获取直方图/上游时延、没有依赖在 11:24-11:26 的采样、没有配置回读。按上报的服务，受影响组件为 front-door（root_service 本应为 front-door），但机制无法在可见证据下确定，因此按 insufficient_evidence 提交，不给出猜测性归因或置信度。注意：不能把 event-store 的健康外推到所有依赖，也不能把抓取缺口当作依赖故障证据。

H2.statement: front-door 500s at 11:24-11:26 are caused by a slow/unresponsive downstream dependency (timeouts), not local front-door saturation. Supporting: front-door CPU/memory normal at fault (ev_4b9bf3276a19), and invoice-api/account-api telemetry gaps in the fault window leave dependency degradation plausible. Contradicting: event-store measured healthy during 11:25-11:26 (9ms p95, 0 lock waiters, ev_563b24dc82a1); no timeout/exception evidence in front-door logs (ev_423d91c387c3); no upstream timing retained. Next check: dependency-specific latency/error metrics inside 11:24-11:26.
H2.next_check: Look for downstream timeout/error logs or latency metrics in fault window; check whether a deploy/config change at ~11:21 correlates.

H3.statement: A configuration change rolled out around 11:21 (config delta sync failed at 11:21) broke /submit routing/limits, producing 500s at 11:24-11:26. Supporting: config delta synchronization failed at 11:21, runtime readback and revision membership for the fault window not retained (ev_8753dba7df6f). Contradicting: no retained readback or revision membership confirms any bad config value during the fault window; failure of delta sync is a telemetry loss, not evidence of a bad config. Next check: any retained config readback or deployment revision for front-door around 11:21-11:26.
H3.next_check: Search front-door changes/logs for a concrete config value applied in the fault window.

H1.statement: front-door pool exhaustion to a downstream dependency causes the /submit 500 burst (420/6000, 11:24-11:26). Supporting: local resources normal (CPU 26%, mem 380MiB) while error rate jumps from 0.03% to 7%; event-store healthy (query p95 9ms, lock_waiters=0) in the window. Contradicting: no connection-acquisition histogram or upstream timing retained; the single error log has redacted exception_class/upstream_name; invoice-api and account-api have no in-window samples, so the callers of a saturated pool cannot be identified.
H1.next_check: Search front-door logs for pool/connection keywords and runbooks for pool signature; if no discriminator, abstain.
